candidates.source_title: The tragic story of Louise Delabigne #history
candidates.source_description:
Louise Delabigne came from a difficult background, but over time her charm and presence opened doors to some of the most powerful circles in Paris.

She became closely connected to wealthy and influential men, including princes and members of royal society.

But even after finding love and building a family, her life took another unexpected turn — one that made her choose independence over everything else.
